verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Runpod offers current-generation H100 GPUs easily (unlike Colab) and previous-generation cards like the RTX 4090, aligning with the story's ask for both tiers, but the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation enumerating specific GPU classes (H100/H200/B200) or pricing tiers per model, and one community report flags intermittent low availability of certain GPU types. missing for 10: official docs listing available GPU models/generations and confirmation of B200/H200 availability, independent corroboration of consistent access across tiers.
